items.title: COP31 dates and venue
items.summary: UNFCCC lists COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, on November 9–20, 2026.
items.verification_note: Official conference information checked November 17. This is logistical context, not an outcome.

items.title: Published resumed high-level segment programme
items.summary: The UNFCCC notice dated November 16 schedules the resumed high-level segment for November 17–18. Publication of the notice is verified; individual interventions and their outcomes are not inferred.
items.verification_note: Notice read on November 17; source date November 16, 2026.

items.title: Final Negotiations
items.summary: The Presidency thematic programme lists Day 12 as Final Negotiations. Timing and completion remain subject to the negotiations.
items.verification_note: Official indexed programme retrieved November 17; direct page access timed out. Recheck the live programme before publication.

items.title: Closing plenaries
items.summary: The secretariat planning note envisages COP31, CMP21 and CMA8 closing plenaries on November 20. This is a preliminary organizational scenario, not confirmation of final adoption.

items.title: Connect To Funds — Green Zone
items.summary: The Presidency programme lists Finance and Incentives Day / Connect To Funds, 10:00–17:00 Antalya time (04:00–11:00 Brasília). No funding delivery is inferred.
items.verification_note: Official indexed programme retrieved November 17; direct page access timed out. Schedule may change.
